title: Safety Officer Salary: Hourly to Annual Conversion Guide for 2026-27
description: Calculate your safety officer salary from hourly to annual, fortnightly, after tax and super. Includes national minimum wage, award rates, casual loading, and tax for 2026-27.
salarySummary: A safety officer on the national minimum wage of $26.44 per hour (38-hour week) earns $52,254.80 annually before tax, but award rates and experience often push safety officer salary higher.

faqs.q: What is the national minimum wage for a safety officer in 2026?
faqs.a: From 1 July 2026 the national minimum wage is $26.44 per hour, $1004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual safety officers get 25% loading on top ($33.05 per hour). Most safety officers are covered by an award, which may pay higher minimum rates. Check the Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides for your specific award.

faqs.q: How do I convert my hourly rate to annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate × hours per week × 52. For a full-time safety officer working 38 hours, annual gross = hourly × 38 × 52. For example, $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.80. The fortnightly pay is weekly × 2. This assumes no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice.

faqs.q: Does superannuation part of my salary?
faqs.a: No. Super is paid on top of your ordinary earnings. From 1 July 2026 the super guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. For a $52,254.80 annual gross, super is about $6,270.60 per year (12% of $52,254.80) but it is not included in your take-home pay.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding Your Safety Officer Salary

When you have an hourly rate or a salary offer, you want to know the annual figure, the fortnight, the tax, and the super. This guide uses the 38-hour week, the Fair Work Commission, the Fair Work Ombudsman, the Australian Bureau of Statistics, and the Australian Taxation Office figures. Use the keyword "safety officer salary" naturally in the title and body.

### Hourly to Annual Conversion

The formula: hourly × hours per week × 52. This assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is paid on top, at 12% of ordinary earnings, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare levy generally 2%. The fortnight is weekly × 2.

From 1 July 2026 the national minimum wage is $26.44 per hour, $1004.9 per week for 38 hours. Casual loading 25% on top ($33.05 per hour. The Fair Work Commission sets the national minimum wage. The Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides have the minimum pay rates for full-time, part-time and casual employees in an award. The Australian Bureau of Statistics Average Weekly Earnings, May 2026 full-time adult ordinary time $2083.7 per week. All employees total earnings $1579.2 per week (includes part-time. Resident tax 2026–27: nil to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above that. Medicare levy generally 2%.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

From 1 July 2026 award minimum wages increase by 4.75%. The national minimum wage is $26.44 per hour. The Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides have the minimum pay rates for full-time, part-time and casual employees in an award. The Fair Work Commission has the Modern Awards Pay Database. The Modern Awards Pay Database contains the calculated minimum rates of pay, allowances, overtime and penalty rates in modern awards. The data for each modern award is divided into 5 spreadsheets: awards, classifications, wage-related allowances, expense-related allowances, penalty rates.

Safety officer salary may be covered by an award like the Manufacturing Award or Health Services Award. Use the Fair Work Ombudsman pay guides for your award. The pay guides have the minimum pay rates for full-time, part-time and casual employees in an award. They also include all the monetary allowances and the most frequently used penalty rates for each classification. Pay guides don’t apply when a business has an enterprise agreement and the employee is covered by it.

### Casual Loading and Super

Casual loading 25% on top. Super 12% on top. For a safety officer on $26.44 per hour casual $33.05 per hour including 25% loading. The fortnight is weekly × 2. For example $1004.9 per week × 2 = $2009.8 per fortnight. Super on top: 12% of $1004.9 = $120.59 per week. Super stops at $270,830 maximum contribution base.

### Tax and Medicare

Tax 2026–27: nil to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above. Medicare levy 2%. For $52,254.8 annual: first $18,200 nil, next $26,800 at 15% = $4,020; remaining $7,254.8 at 30% = $2,176.44; total tax $6,196.44. Medicare 2% = $1,045.1. Net annual $45,013.26. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax. Use the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted.

### Fortnightly Pay

Weekly gross $1004.9 per week, fortnightly $2009.8. After tax and Medicare $6,196.44 tax and $1,045.1 levy. Net fortnightly $1,768.26. This assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, no salary sacrifice. Super is paid on top, at 12% of ordinary earnings, and stops at $270,830 maximum contribution base.
